messages.subject: Issue trying to configure my account to use ShinyApps
parts:
Hello,

I have set up an account using my GMAIL details - have logged into ShinyApps.io - obtained Token and Secret. My problem is this : Im getting the below error. 

> shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name="Emma", token="*****************", secret="*************")
Error in shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name = "Emma", token = "***********",  : 
  Unable to determine account id for account named Emma'

for the purpose of this post, I have replaced my Token and secret with ***** symbols.

I have tried replacing my name with my GMAIL email address - the name I am using is the name that displays in the top right hand corner of the ShinyApps.io page where I obtained my token and secret from.

Also, the copy button is not working on that page.

Im using Firefox 27.0.1

Thanks,

Emma

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Issue trying to configure my account to use ShinyApps
parts:
Hi Jan,
Apologies for the hassle.  We are working on a revamp of the UI which should hopefully address all those issues.  Right now, the easiest way to find it would be to login into: my.shinyapps.io, click on the Apps tab, and then hover over one of your apps.  If you don't have any apps installed, you could also find the account name by clicking on your name on the top right drop down in the menu, select tokens, and click the copy button (next to the trash bin).  That will copy the full command to be run in R to configure your accountInfo into the clipboard and if you were to paste it in your favorite text editor you can see the account name in there.

Apologies once again for the kludgy UI, we have been much more focused on the reliability and scalability of the service over the past 3 weeks, but will be looking to enhance the first time user experience and the manageability of user accounts in the coming month.

Best,
Tareef
